newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch guilder rates edge up but trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Dutch guilder rates edge up but trade thin.

text.p: Dutch money rates edged up fractionally across the board on Monday, but dealers said volumes were minimal.

Overnight guilders were up around six basis points in the morning session at 3.12-3.18 percent, while three-, six- and 12-month guilders were all quoted up two basis points at 3.24, 3.32 and 3.44 percent bid, respectively.
But dealers said the higher prices would not necessarily lead to a rise in short-term liquidity rates. They said the guilder's relative softness against the mark was amid light volume.
The guilder was bid at 112.65 per 100 marks on Monday, unchanged from its Friday fixing.
Some traders expected a rise in the special advances rate if guilder/mark reaches 112.670.
The guilder/mark parity within the exchange rate mechanism has been set at 112.673 guilders per 100 marks.
